authoredFrom: SQLD6 (M60 SQL wave, 2026-09-26). Keyword targets and builtin leakage were measured together over the real corpus by bb_tests/sql/probe/corpus-sweep.mts: 49 edges whose target is a SQL reserved word (`calls global->USING`, `uses global->WITH`, `calls get_brand_network_stats->FILTER`), and bb_tests/sql/probe/edge-resolvability.mts showed the dominant unresolvable-edge causes to be `generate_series`, `jsonb_build_object`, `current_setting`, `set_config` and `cardinality` - all functions SQL provides, none of which were in the 37-entry builtin list.
comment: The last expect row is the CONTROL: `d6_project_function` has the same shape as every suppressed builtin, so a fix that simply drops calls passes all the forbid rows and fails this one. Without it the fixture would reward over-suppression.
